# DialKit 2.0.0

Vendored unmodified from the npm `dialkit@2.0.0` package:
- `dist/vanilla/browser.global.js`
- `dist/vanilla/styles.css`
- `LICENSE` (MIT, Josh Puckett)

Source: https://github.com/joshpuckett/dialkit
These browser assets require no framework or runtime dependencies. `review.py`
inlines them so review pages work without a CDN, npm, or a build step.
Update both assets together from a pinned version, retaining its license.
